title: 1 Hour Private Electric Duffy Cruise on Lake Austin
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Lake Austin in chic comfort aboard the only air-conditioned boat on the lake. 

Our elegant Duffy features floor-to-ceiling window panes for panoramic views of the stunning waterfront homes, whether you’re soaking in the daytime scenery or catching a breathtaking sunset. 

Settle into the plush, open-air bench seating to enjoy the gentle lake breeze, toast with friends, or share a romantic moment.

This sophisticated yet inviting cruise is perfect for bachelorette parties, date nights, brunch outings, anniversaries, birthdays, or simply a stylish day on the water with your favorite people.

Food & beverage can be pre-ordered from Quince Lakehouse.

(No outside food or beverage) 

Q: Where do I meet my captain?
A: Arrive at Quince Lakehouse 15 minutes before departure time. Check in at the host stand. Your captain will meet you at the front reception area of Quince.
